title: Measures to Enhance Food Safety Standards and Penalties for Breaches in Light of Recent Mass Food Poisoning Cases
what_it_is: Measures to Enhance Food Safety Standards and Penalties for Breaches in Light of Recent Mass Food Poisoning Cases

sections.label: SFA food safety enforcement
sections.summary: SFA works with sectoral agencies, uses a data-driven risk-based approach, steps up surveillance on higher-concern businesses, and enforces lapses under a Points Demerit System.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: SFA also works closely with sectoral agencies, such as with the Early Childhood Development Agency for preschools and the Ministry of Health for nursing homes, on guidelines and regulations to protect vulnerable communities against food safety incidents.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: SFA adopts a data-driven and risk-based approach to ensure food safety requirements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Food businesses of higher regulatory concern, such as those with track records of past infringements, are subjected to stepped-up surveillance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: During its inspections, SFA enforces against food safety lapses detected and administers a Points Demerit System under which licences may be suspended or cancelled.

sections.label: Review of food safety penalties
sections.summary: SFA regularly reviews its food safety regime to ensure offences and penalties deter violations, with a current review underway as part of the upcoming Food Safety and Security Bill.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: SFA regularly reviews its food safety regime to ensure that offences and penalties are adequate and effective to deter violations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: A current review is underway as part of the upcoming Food Safety and Security Bill.
